facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of Hanoi, within walking distance of the Hanoi Opera House, the Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem Lake and the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Hanoi, the hotel is within walking distance of several city attractions, such as the Hanoi Opera House, the city’s Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem Lake and the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre.

facts.text: The hotel is adjacent to the Hanoi Opera House.
facts.excerpt: A link to the Hotel’s location adjacent to the  Hanoi Opera House

facts.text: The hotel's opera theme is carried through every corner, bringing operatic and theatrical flair to the interior design.
facts.excerpt: The theme of the hotel is interpreted in every corner, bringing operatic and theatrical flair to the interior design.

facts.text: The hotel is on Hanoi's historic Trang Tien Street.
facts.excerpt: Combining elements of artistry in the heart of Hanoi's historic Trang Tien Street

facts.text: The semi-outdoor heated pool and terrace offer views toward the Opera House and Trang Tien Street.
facts.excerpt: The semi-outdoor heated pool and terrace offer familiar views toward the Opera House and Tràng Tiền Street

facts.text: Wellness facilities include a semi-outdoor heated pool, Harmonie Spa, a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center.
facts.excerpt: There's a semi-outdoor heated pool, Harmonie Spa, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center

facts.text: Lautrec is the hotel's glass-roofed French brasserie set in a dramatic atrium.
facts.excerpt: Lautrec, the soaring glass-roofed French brasserie whose dramatic atrium is the hotel's most beautiful and distinct space

facts.text: Afternoon tea at Lautrec is served inside a lacquer music box.
facts.excerpt: Served inside a lacquer music box with a choice of TWG tea or Maison Marou hot chocolate

facts.text: La Fee Verte is the hotel's absinthe bar.
facts.excerpt: La Fée Verte—Hanoi's only dedicated absinthe bar—has become a city institution

facts.text: Inspired by the neighboring Opera House, rooms feature velvet upholstery, dark timber floors, jewel-toned fabrics and artwork drawn from the performing arts.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the neighboring Opera House, the rooms feature velvet upholstery, dark timber floors, jewel-toned fabrics, and artwork drawn from the performing arts.

facts.text: Bathrooms have illuminated mirrors that evoke backstage dressing rooms.
facts.excerpt: I particularly liked the bathrooms, with illuminated mirrors that evoke backstage dressing rooms

facts.text: Working with Vietnam's National Archives, the hotel reproduced the Opera House's original architectural blueprints as artwork displayed throughout the property.
facts.excerpt: Working with Vietnam's National Archives, the hotel reproduced the Opera House's original architectural blueprints as artwork displayed throughout the property

facts.text: The hotel opened in 2011 on the site of the former Dan Chu Hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hotel de l'Opéra opened in 2011 on the site of the former Dân Chủ Hotel

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as an award-winning luxury boutique hotel.
Some guest rooms were refreshed in a renovation completed in 2025 and renovations can be ongoing.
facts.excerpt: A major renovation completed in 2025 refreshed many of the guest rooms while preserving the hotel's distinctive character.
